verdict.rationale: A cloud application platform that hosts customer code and data could plausibly publish an AI-training opt-out or data-use guarantee, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers AI training data use, opt-out controls, or a privacy policy on model training. The MCP server, agent skills and managed OIDC items describe a different capability and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
